title: Setup forms show each error toast twice ("A record with this value already exists" ×2 on 5 forms), and the toast stack covers the page's header buttons for ~4 s — one toast per error, placed clear of the header actions (hotcrm#2194 R2-T2-U08)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 5 个 Setup 表单的每条错误提示都弹两次，提示堆叠在右上角盖住「新建」「导入」按钮约 4 秒，期间点不了。
- **要做：** 每个错误只提示一次，提示位置不遮挡页面头部按钮。
- **完成标准：** 一次错误一条提示，头部按钮始终可点。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U08**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Pages / persona:** many Setup forms, the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** each error toast appears twice ("A record with this value already exists" ×2, "Either email or phoneNumber is required" ×2, "User is not a member of the organization" ×2). The toast stack sits top-right over the page's header buttons (New, Import) for about 4 s.
- **Cost:** measured on 5 forms; the covered New button cannot be clicked while the toast shows.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-08; [`09-people-business-units-org-chart.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/09-people-business-units-org-chart.png).

## Landing

- The console's action/form error handler (two paths both toasting one refusal) and the toaster's placement. The dev finds the second emitter rather than de-duplicating toasts by text.

## Done when

- One refusal produces one toast on the 5 forms the pass named (business unit, user, team member and the others in the report).
- Toasts do not cover the page header's actions at 1440×900.
- Tests on the handler (one emit per refusal).

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `toast`. 4 hits, all closed (#13207, #13205, #13178, #13146), each a different toast defect. Not the duplicate. **New.**
